688271.SS.longBusinessSummary: Shanghai United Imaging Healthcare Co., Ltd. engages in the provision, development, and production of advanced medical imaging solutions, radiotherapy equipment, life science instruments, and intelligent digital solutions worldwide. The company provides molecular imaging products; and magnetic resonance imaging solutions. It also offers computed tomography equipment; digital radiography equipment; mammography equipment; angiography equipment; mobile C-arm equipment; and radiotherapy systems comprising uRT-linac 506c, uRT-linac 306, and Intelligent RT Cloud Ecosystem. In addition, it provides uVision, a remote vision system that enables real-time positioning observation and automatic field of view identification; a low-dose, 3D mammography platform; and Remote Vision and Exposure Control technology application, a handheld X-ray from UIH that enables accurate positioning while reducing exposure radiation. Further, the company offers United Neuro, a medical imaging software used to analyze functional magnetic resonance imaging and diffusion tensor imaging data, and U-VIEWER, software that helps in viewing DICOM images. Additionally, it provides training, monitoring, maintenance, and troubleshooting services. Shanghai United Imaging Healthcare Co., Ltd. was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
